recent_entries.message: Added async runtime dependencies and completed database queries with tests
Completed overlay filesystem operations: rename, setattr, mkdir, symlink, readdir with tests
Implemented NFSFileSystem trait with Arc<Mutex> + spawn_blocking for thread safety, all 14 methods with async tests
Added NFS server infrastructure: NfsServer::start() with port binding, mount_nfs/unmount_nfs helpers for macOS mount_nfs command
Implemented CLI with clap (all commands defined) and mount/unmount commands with state tracking, signal handling, and user-friendly output
Implemented run command: creates temporary overlay, mounts via NFS, runs command in sandbox, unmounts, prompts accept/reject (change detection stubs for phase 3)
Implemented diff/accept/reject commands: auto-discovery of .loaf files, colored diff output (A/M/D), apply changes to real filesystem with permissions, whiteout handling
